transcript: What are you doing? I'm watching a meme. What's wrong? It's gonna sound really stupid. Sweetie, what? I just miss being pregnant. You miss being pregnant? I just miss being able to feel her little kicks. I haven't had one single crepey. Sweetie! I just miss my belly, my table. I love Ellie so much. It went by way too fast. I know other people would disagree, but I feel like it went by really fast. Like I had Texas Roadhouse rolls, which were amazing. Why are you sad? I'm never going to look at Texas Roadhouse Rolls the same ever again. What? Why am I like this? This is normal. It's normal to feel emotions after giving birth. But she's so perfect. She's so perfect because you had such a perfect pregnancy. Did she just smile? Mm-hmm. I missed it. I slept with her in my belly for nine months. And now she has to sleep in this cold, empty, hard bassinet without me. I can't fit in the bassinet, Taylor. You can't. It's meant for baby. I want a nugget. What's that? I want a nugget in my belly. You're already naming the next one. See, she wants nugget too. Do you need anything? White bean soup. White bean soup? Oh my god. Fine. I'm gonna go get the stuff. Okay.
metadata_caption: She already wants a “nugget” 😳 backstory ::: My wife has just given birth to our beautiful daughter. She is so excited to finally have Ellie here, but is sad that her pregnancy is over. Kay gave birth before her due date, and was not expecting it to happen the night it did. We were on a date, having dinner, and she started getting contractions. Soon after, she went into labor. It was very random and so to her, it felt like one moment she was pregnant, and the next she wasnt. She misses the kicks, and the cravings, and the experience of being pregnant. 😔 Kay had such a beautiful pregnancy journey and it was so much fun seeing her slowly grow our daughter! I loved every minute of it, and think that she did an amazing job getting through pregnancy. Since Kay just gave birth, she has been extra emotional, which is likely why she is so sad about not being pregnant. Over time, this sadness will go away and all that will be left are the wonderful memories we made. ❤️ #kayandtayofficial #couples #pregnant #postpartum
